presentation.description: Keep your shield between danger and your companions, then make enemies regret trying to fight past it. Attacks against nearby allies build force behind your next melee blow, while a sudden shield bash can stop a marked enemy cold with a stun. Between sheltering adjacent allies from incoming fire, reinforcing your own defenses, and answering a missed melee attack with dazing, weakening pressure, you give the party a sturdy place to rally.
